blocks.summary_zh: debounce 防抖：连续调用只执行最后一次，适合搜索输入等高频场景
blocks.summary_en: debounce: collapse bursts of calls into the last one — for search inputs and other high-frequency events

lines.zh: 模块说明：防抖、API 客户端、轮询订阅三个浏览器小工具
lines.en: Module comment: debounce, API client, and polling helpers

lines.zh: 导出 `debounce(fn, wait=300)`：包装 `fn`，静默 `wait` 毫秒后才执行 {
lines.en: Export `debounce(fn, wait=300)`: wrap `fn` to run only after `wait` ms of silence {

lines.zh: `timer` 存在闭包里 → 被返回的函数共享，每次调用都能取消上一次
lines.en: `timer` lives in the closure → shared by the returned function so each call cancels the previous one

lines.zh: 先清除未触发的定时器 → 只要还在连续调用，执行就被不断推迟（防抖核心）
lines.en: Clear the pending timer → while calls keep coming, execution keeps being postponed (the debounce core)

lines.zh: 重新计时 `wait` 毫秒 → 到点以原 `this` 和参数执行 `fn`
lines.en: Restart a `wait` ms timer → on fire, invoke `fn` with the original `this` and args

blocks.summary_zh: ApiClient 构造：规范化 baseUrl，保存超时与重试配置
blocks.summary_en: ApiClient constructor: normalize baseUrl, store timeout and retry settings

lines.zh: 构造函数：第二参数可整体省略，`timeout` 默认 8 秒、`retries` 默认 2 {
lines.en: Constructor: options object optional; `timeout` defaults to 8s, `retries` to 2 {

lines.zh: `baseUrl` 去掉末尾斜杠 → 避免拼 path 出现双斜杠
lines.en: Strip trailing slash from `baseUrl` → avoids double slashes when joining paths

blocks.summary_zh: request 主流程：AbortController 管超时，失败按指数退避重试，最后统一抛错
blocks.summary_en: request core: AbortController enforces timeout, failures retry with exponential backoff, last error is thrown

lines.zh: 新建 `AbortController` → 超时后用它中断 fetch
lines.en: New `AbortController` → used to abort fetch on timeout

lines.zh: 启动超时定时器 → 到点调用 `abort()`，挂起的 fetch 以 `AbortError` 失败
lines.en: Start timeout timer → on fire `abort()` rejects the pending fetch with `AbortError`

lines.zh: `lastError` 先留空 → 记录最后一次错误
lines.en: `lastError` starts empty → tracks the most recent failure

lines.zh: 循环 `attempt` 从 0 到 `retries`（含）→ 首次尝试 + 若干次重试 {
lines.en: Loop `attempt` from 0 through `retries` → initial try plus retries {

lines.zh: 展开调用方的 `options`（方法、body 等）
挂上 `signal` → 超时机制由此生效
lines.en: Attach the `signal` → this is what makes the timeout work

lines.zh: 合并请求头：默认 JSON，调用方可覆盖
lines.en: Merge headers: JSON by default, caller can override

lines.zh: 若 响应非 2xx → 抛出 `HTTP 状态码` 错误（fetch 只对网络错误 reject，必须手动检查）
lines.en: If response not ok → throw `HTTP status` error (fetch only rejects on network failure, so check manually)

lines.zh: 解析 JSON 并直接返回 → 成功即跳出整个重试循环
lines.en: Parse and return JSON → success exits the retry loop entirely

lines.zh: 若 是超时 `AbortError` → 直接跳出，不再重试（后端慢时重试只会雪上加霜）
lines.en: If it's a timeout `AbortError` → break without retrying (retrying a slow backend makes things worse)

lines.zh: 等待 `2^attempt × 200` 毫秒后再试 → 指数退避
lines.en: Wait `2^attempt × 200` ms before the next try → exponential backoff

lines.zh: 清除超时定时器 → 请求已结束，不再触发无意义的 `abort`
lines.en: Clear the timeout → no pointless `abort` after the request settled

lines.zh: 抛出 `lastError` → 所有尝试失败，错误交给调用方
lines.en: Throw `lastError` → all attempts failed, propagate to the caller

blocks.summary_zh: get/post 便捷封装：复用 request，post 自动序列化 JSON
blocks.summary_en: get/post shorthands: thin wrappers over request; post serializes the body as JSON

lines.zh: 转发给 `request`：方法 POST，`body` 先 `JSON.stringify`（与默认 JSON 请求头呼应）
lines.en: Forward to `request`: method POST, body `JSON.stringify`'d (matching the default JSON header)

blocks.summary_zh: poll 轮询：每轮执行任务 → 等一个间隔 → 再检查停止条件；返回可随时调用的停止函数
blocks.summary_en: poll: run task → wait an interval → re-check stop conditions; returns a stop function callable anytime

lines.zh: 导出 `poll(fn, interval, shouldStop)`：`fn` 每轮执行，`shouldStop` 由调用方给终止条件 {
lines.en: Export `poll(fn, interval, shouldStop)`: `fn` runs per round; `shouldStop` is the caller's termination condition {

lines.zh: 内部停止标志 `stopped` 置假 → 与 `shouldStop` 构成两种停止途径
lines.en: Internal `stopped` flag starts false → a second stop path alongside `shouldStop`

lines.zh: 循环条件：未内部停止 且 外部条件未满足 {
lines.en: Loop while not stopped internally and externally {

lines.zh: 只警告不中断 → 轮询场景要的是「下轮再试」而非整体崩溃
lines.en: Warn only, don't break → polling prefers 'retry next round' over crashing

lines.zh: 等 `interval` 毫秒 → 非阻塞，不卡页面其他逻辑
lines.en: Wait `interval` ms → non-blocking, the page stays responsive

lines.zh: 启动 `tick`（故意不 `await`）→ 后台自行轮询，`poll` 立即返回
lines.en: Start `tick` (deliberately not awaited) → polls in background, `poll` returns at once

lines.zh: 返回停止函数：调用它 → `stopped` 置真，下一轮循环退出
lines.en: Return a stop function: calling it sets `stopped`, ending the next loop check
